issues.description: The ManuallyDrop specification migration removes ex_manually_drop_value_axiom but leaves an enabled FVT5 proof broadcasting that deleted item, so the proof-retaining target refers to a nonexistent symbol.
issues.rationale: The first PR commit deletes the axiom from vstd_extra::manually_drop. A full fixed-tree symbol search finds only the remaining broadcast use in the page module; fvt5 lib.rs enables page and vstd_extra lib.rs enables manually_drop. The immediate next PR commit deletes that stale broadcast use. This is an intermediate proof-name resolution defect, not a claim that the final adjudicated no-findings head is faulty or that the retained ManuallyDrop model is unsound.
issues.verification: source-only; historical Verus not executed. Read fixed module declarations, complete migrated specification file, fixed-tree symbol search, official two-commit PR list and direct repair diff.
